Samir — thanks for the note and the logo. Very happy to do this. Quick checklist from our side so we can move fast: 

- Confirmed short quote text (you included it above) — can you confirm attribution exactly as you want it to appear?
- Legal sign-off: please have an authorized signatory at VividTech confirm the quote and permission to use the logo (PDF/email ok).
- Asset specs we need: SVG or EPS for logo, and a headshot if you want a person included. We’ll create a quote card PNG and draft social copy for you to approve.
- Usage: website feature and two social posts (LinkedIn, X) for up to 12 months — confirm if that works for you or if you need different constraints.

Ben/Marissa — looping you in for the final creative and to track the approval in HubSpot (Deal RDW-4521-VIV).
